purpose: Use the first available desktop browser session to recover the exact served evidence that most efficiently closes the remaining evidence gates on the four highest-priority EDGE lanes. The capture itself never authorizes a wager.

commonCaptureProtocol.browser: Desktop Chromium-family browser with DevTools Network export available
beforeOpeningTarget: Open DevTools Network before launching the target game.
Disable cache while DevTools is open.
Clear the Network log immediately before the target launch so the HAR is attributable to one target session.
duringCapture: Launch only the exact target game/page listed for the lane.
Allow the game and jackpot/state UI to finish loading without placing a wager.
Open the exact in-game Help/Rules/Paytable screens when available so served rule bodies can enter the passive capture.
Do not use any wager/spin/draw/deal button.
export: Export one HAR with content after the target session has fully loaded.
Keep the original HAR private; EDGE analyzers emit only redacted structural evidence.
Do not edit timestamps, response bodies, URLs or ordering before analysis.

explicitlyFrozenOut.reason: Exact title collides across IGT and Realtime Gaming/RTG lineages. It remains excluded from the unified P0 capture command until the served EnRacha provider identity is established; title and RTP alone cannot promote it into the IGT persistent-state model.

successDefinitionForFirstPcSession: Success means recovering reviewable exact served evidence that closes one or more current gates. It does not mean a GREEN signal, guaranteed profit or permission to wager.
